[T101] [GEO=city:Shanghang county town, Longyan, Fujian, coordinates from OSM Nominatim page S3] Row notes (T006) place the plant in the 'Shanghang Baisha new-materials park'; Nominatim found no Baisha entry (empty result), so this is the county town, an approximation not the site.

[T101] [GEO=city:Pingdingshan, Henan, coordinates from OSM Nominatim administrative-boundary label point, page S4] Row notes (T040) place the project in the Xinhua High-tech Industrial Park, Pingdingshan; the park was not placed (Nominatim's 平顶山高新技术产业开发区 hit is a Ye County boundary that could not be tied to 'Xinhua'). City-level approximation.

[T101] [GEO=city:Yibin city place node, Sichuan, coordinates from OSM Nominatim page S5] Row notes (T021): 'Yibin Energy Storage Industrial Park (Sichuan)'; the park itself was not found in Nominatim (search returned an unrelated Suqian result), so this is the Yibin city point, not the site.

[T101] [GEO=town:Jiangning Economic and Technological Development Zone, Moling subdistrict, Jiangning, Nanjing, coordinates from OSM Nominatim page S6 (point = the zone's law-enforcement office inside the zone, NOT the plant)].
